cases.name: valid_even_square
cases.challenge:

theorem main_theorem (n : ℤ) (h : Even n) : Even (n ^ 2) := sorry
cases.solution:

theorem main_theorem (n : ℤ) (h : Even n) : Even (n ^ 2) := by

cases.name: valid_open_interval_refutation
cases.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Set

def Claim : Prop :=
  ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Ioo 0 1) → ∃ x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, IsMaxOn f (Ioo 0 1) x

theorem main_theorem : ¬ Claim := sorry
cases.solution:
import Mathlib

open Set

def Claim : Prop :=
  ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Ioo 0 1) → ∃ x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, IsMaxOn f (Ioo 0 1) x

theorem main_theorem : ¬ Claim := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨hx0, hx1⟩, hmax⟩ := h id continuousOn_id
  have hy : (x + 1) / 2 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have : (x + 1) / 2 ≤ x := hmax hy
  linarith
